name: Voxel Volume Rendering
definition: Rendering a 3D scalar field as a voxel volume using ray marching through a Data3DTexture in a Three.js scene, supporting both block-style (crisp) and smooth compositing.
summary: Voxel volume rendering visualizes 3D scalar fields by projecting light through discrete voxel grids, differing from isosurface methods by revealing internal density variations rather than single boundaries.
